trans.en: In the Name of Allah, the most Gracious, the most Merciful.
trans.rurdu: (Shuru karta hu) Allah ke naam se Jo bada maher-baan nehaayat rahem karne waala hai.
trans.urdu: اللہ کے نام سے (شروع کرتا ہوں) جو بڑا مہربا ن نہایت رحم کرنے والا ہے۔

arabic.text: يَا اللهُ يَا رَحْمَانُ يَا رَحِيْمُ يَا عَلِيْمُ يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّوْمُ۔ اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّيْ لَا اَسْئَلُكَ بِعَمَلِيْ شَيْئًا اِنِّيْ مِنْ عَمَلِيْ خَاۗئِفٌ اِنَّمَا اَسْئَلُكَ بِرَحْمَتِكَ مَا اَسْئَلُكَ فَصَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّآلِهٖ وَهَبْ لِيْ مِنْ طَاعَتِكَ مَا يُرْضِيْكَ عَنِّيْ وَتَقَبَّلْ صَوْمِيْ وَتَفَضَّلْ عَلَيَّ بِرَحْمَتِكَ وَارْحَمْنِيْ بِرَحْمَتِكَ يَا اَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِيْنَ۔

lines.rarabic: YAA ALLAAHO YAA RAHMAANO YAA RAHEEMO YAA A’LEEMO YAA HAIYYO YAA QAYYUMO. ALLAAHUMMA INNEE LAA AS-ALOKA BE-A’MALEE SHAIY-AN INNEE MIN A’MALEE KHAA-E-FOON INNA-MAA AS-ALOKA BE-RAH-MATEKA MAA AS-ALOKA FA-SALLE A’LAA MOHAMMADIW WA AALE-HI WA HAB-LEE MIN TAA-A’TE-KA MAA YURZEE-KA A’NNEE WA TA-QABBAL SAWMEE WA TA-FAZZAL A’LAIYYA BE-RAH-MATEKA BE-RAH-MATEKA BE-RAH-MATEKA YAA AR-HAMAR RAAHE-MEENA.

trans.en: O God! O Compassionate! O Merciful O All-Knowing! O the Living! O the Eternal! O my God! I do not ask You for anything due to my deeds since I am fearful of my deeds I ask You what I ask due to Your Mercy So, please bestow Your Blessings on Muhammad and his Progeny. Please grant me success in doing acts of Your Obedience such as to please You accept my fasting and favor me with Your Mercy and have mercy on me using Your Mercy, O the Most Compassionate, Most Merciful.
trans.urdu: انشاء اللہ ترجمہ جلد آرہا ہے

arabic.text: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّيْ اَدْعُوْكَ وَاَسْئَلُكَ بِاَسْمَاۗئِكَ الْحُسْنٰى وَبِاسْمِكَ الْعَظِيْمِ وَ وَجْهِكَ الْكَرِيْمِ وَمُلْكِكَ الْقَدِيْمِ وَرُوْحِكَ الْقُدُّوْسِ وَكَلَامِكَ الطَّيِّبِ وَمُلْكِكَ الدَّاۗئِمِ الْعَظِيْمِ وَسُلْطَانِكَ الْمُنِيْرِ وَقُرْآنِكَ الْحَكِيْمِ وَعَطَاۗئِكَ الْجَلِيْلِ الْجَزِيْلِ وَبِاسْمِكَ الَّذِيْ اِذَا دُعِيْتَ بِهٖ اَجَبْتَ وَاِذَا سُئِلْتَ بِهٖ اَعْطَيْتَ اَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَاَنْ تُعْتِقَنِيْ مِنَ النَّارِ فِيْ هٰذَا الشَّهْرِ الْمُبَارَكِ فَاِنِّيْ فَقِيْرٌ مِسْكِيْنٌ اِلٰى رَحْمَتِكَ يَا اَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِيْنَ۔

lines.rarabic: ALLAAHUMMA INNEE AD-O’O-KA WA AS-ALOKA BE-ASMAA-E-KAL HUSNAA WA BISME-KAL A’ZEEME WA WAJHE-KAL KAREEME WA MULKE-KAL QADEEME WA ROOHE-KAL QUDDOO-SE WA KALAAME-KAT TAIYYE-BE WA MULKE-KAD DAAA-E-MIL A’ZEEME WA SULTAANE-KAL MONEE-RE WA QURAANE-KAL HAKEEME WA A’TAA-E-KAL JALEE-LIL JAZEE-LE WA BISME-KAL LAZEE IZAA DO-E’E-TA WA IZAA SO-ILTA BEHI A’TAIY-TA AN TO-SALLE-YA A’LAA MOHAMMADIW WA AALE MOHAMMADIN WA AN TO’TE-QANEE MENAN NAARE FEE HAA-ZASH SHAH-RIL MOBAA-RAKE FA-INNEE FAQEE-ROON MISKEE-NOON ILAA RAH-MATE-KA YAA AR-HAMAR RAAHE-MEENA.

trans.en: O my God! I call upon You and ask You through Your Beautiful Names, Your Grand Name, Your Noble Face Your Holy Spirit, Your Pure Words, Your Perpetual and Grand Dominion Your Luminous Authority, Your Wise Quran, and Your Most Majestic and Abundant Gifts! I ask You by Your Name that which when invoked supplications are fulfilled and by that which when invoked favors are granted. I ask You to bestow Your Blessings on Muhammad and his Progeny I ask You to save me from the Fire in this blessed month since indeed I am poor and in need of Your Mercy O the Most Compassionate, Most Merciful.

arabic.text: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ۔

lines.rarabic: ALLAHUMMA SWALLE ALAA MUHAMMADIW WA AALE MUHAMMADIN

trans.en: Allah’s (s.w.t) choicest blessings be upon Mohammed and his holy progeny.
trans.rurdu: Parwardigaar Tu rehmat naazil farma Hazrat Muhammad (s.a.w.a) aur unki Aal (a.s) par.
trans.urdu: اے معبود! رحمت نازل فرما حضرت محمدؐ اور انکی آل ؑپر۔
